blocks.text: Heart Evangelista and John Prats have officially reunited on set as they kicked off filming for their reunion movie slated for release in February 2027. Cornerstone Studios gave a glimpse of the first day of shooting through its social media pages on Thursday, Nov. 5. “After 23 years, JoHeart is finally back together for their first solo movie!
